answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 41143 Country: India Title: Can give zakah to my brother Question: My brother has completed his education and is looking for a job. My father is no more so I am responsible for all his needs. I pay him some amount of money as his monthly expenses. So can I make intention of zakah while giving him the money and will my zakah be valid? Answer ID: 41143 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1271/841/H=1433) If you give your zakah to your brother and make him its owner then your zakah shall be paid and your brother shall be free to spend it where he wishes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
